{{Quote|It makes no difference to me how you came. As long as you have credits.|Unidentified Big Boom bartender|<ref name="invincible" />}}
A '''bartender''' was a [[Lethan/Legends|Lethan]] [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] working on the [[Big Boom]] [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] on [[Nova Station]].<ref name="invincible" />

After escaping imprisonment from the [[Galactic Alliance Guard]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Ben Skywalker]] ordered a [[Fogblaster]] from the bartender, as per instructions given to him by the [[Royal Intelligence Service|Hapan Intelligence]] agents he was to rendezvous with.<ref name="invincible" />
